# Letterdock

> Letterdock is a free, open-source (MIT) email client for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). It supports unlimited email accounts over IMAP and SMTP. Mail is stored on your PC. No subscription and no tracking.

## Main pages
- [Home, features and install steps](https://voydapps.github.io/letterdock/): what Letterdock does, how to install it, FAQ
- [Changelog](https://voydapps.github.io/letterdock/changelog.html): what changed in each version

## Download and source
- [Download for Windows (installer)](https://github.com/voydapps/letterdock/releases/latest/download/Letterdock-Setup.exe)
- [Source code and issues](https://github.com/voydapps/letterdock)
- [All releases](https://github.com/voydapps/letterdock/releases)

## Good to know
- Works now: Gmail (with an app password), Yahoo, iCloud, and any IMAP/SMTP email.
- Not yet: Outlook / Hotmail sign-in ("Sign in with Microsoft" is planned).
- Windows only. No Mac, Linux or phone version.
- The installer is not signed with a paid certificate yet, so Windows may show a warning.
